detail.longDescription: France24 (English) interviews Brookings Inst. expert, a former Obama admin # CyperSecurity czar, about the multiple recent network outages that hit the FAA, airlines, banks, Microsoft, even the NSA. This is a good, thorough discussion in a ten minute brief. Worth watching. The TL;dr is # AI has made exploiting software vulnerabilities much easier and faster - giving offensive hackers an edge. The final question remains, will the defense be able to handle the offense, or will lots of the software we use daily suddenly become unusable? # ArtificialIntelligence # OpSec # AppSec # security # IT https:// youtube.com/watch?v=x70CiWBG_P s&is=oEFIvnMhIvnEv92F
